doc: Firestore document config/costMode. Written only by the kill-switch function onBudgetAlert (or by the owner in the console). See docs/LEARN_GCP.md §6 and docs/BACKEND.md §16.
notes: Moderation (registerCharacter) is never switched off: it is a safety feature and fails closed.
ghostAfterSec = seconds in the matchmaking queue before a ghost opponent is used (GAME_DESIGN_V2 §8: 20 s).
aiEstimateYenPerCall is a deliberately pessimistic estimate of the AI provider cost (billed outside GCP), added to the GCP spend by the kill switch.
